dna.name: House DNA
dna.description: Constants that run under every collection. These make a page recognizably yours regardless of which look you deploy.
constants: One monumental image anchors the page - timeless subject matter (mountains, sea, statues, architecture), never abstract SaaS blobs
Imagery is processed, never raw - halftone, dither, grain, ASCII, linework
Technical marginalia - coordinates, IDs, ruler ticks, registration marks, timestamps
Type at extremes - monumental display or tiny labels, little middle; serif display or giant cropped sans; mono for micro-labels
Near-monochrome ground + single warm accent (ember, amber, terracotta, red)

collections.name: Monumental Editorial
collections.description: Oversized typography, asymmetric white space, and carefully placed gallery images. The layout and type scale carry the identity.
collections.deployFor: Architecture, design studios, portfolios, galleries, and culture brands.
collections.risk: Let a headline span most of the viewport while a small image interrupts its geometry
collections.imageStyle: editorial image of [SUBJECT], deliberate gallery crop, natural material detail, restrained palette, no typography; build the oversized type and white space in code

collections.name: Product-Led Minimalism
collections.description: Clear white landing pages whose main visual is the actual product, framed by a controlled accent or atmospheric background.
collections.deployFor: SaaS platforms, productivity tools, dashboards, and workflow products.
collections.risk: Let a single readable product interaction occupy most of the hero
collections.imageStyle: subtle atmospheric background for [SUBJECT], controlled accent palette and calm center, no UI or text; use real screenshots or code for product demonstrations

collections.name: Technical Systems
collections.description: Instrument-panel precision meets oversized editorial type: maps, sensor imagery, grids, specifications, and sparse signal-orange annotations.
collections.deployFor: Geospatial tools, engineering, robotics, scientific instruments, and technical product storytelling.
collections.risk: Build the page around an annotated visual field with a headline at architectural scale
collections.imageStyle: aerial or sensor-style visualization of [SUBJECT], restrained cinematic contrast, texture and terrain readable, no text or measurements; implement instrument overlays separately in SVG or CSS

collections.name: Luminous Futurism
collections.description: Dark cinematic fields of light, iridescent natural subjects, and optical textures. Bright filaments and bloom establish the atmosphere.
collections.deployFor: Creative technology, AI tools, experimental studios, and expressive product launches.
collections.risk: Make one luminous organic subject the entire hero's focal point
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] illuminated by blue and warm amber light filaments on a deep navy ground, restrained luminous bloom, dimensional texture, deliberate dark copy space, no text

collections.name: Cinematic Still Life
collections.description: Tactile objects staged in dramatic studio light, with quiet negative space and refined typography. Materials and composition convey quality.
collections.deployFor: Premium physical products, craft, hospitality, clubs, and luxury retail.
collections.risk: Let the physical subject and its lighting supply all of the page's decoration
collections.imageStyle: premium studio still life of [SUBJECT], tactile natural materials, dramatic soft side lighting, deep dark backdrop, subject on one side and negative space on the other, no text

collections.name: Print-Tech Paper
collections.description: Crafted-document energy: warm paper grounds, halftone/CMYK texture, registration marks, mono data callouts. The page pretends it was printed and measured.
collections.deployFor: Product sites that should feel crafted, considered, human - tools with a soul.
collections.risk: Render the hero image entirely in halftone dots with visible registration marks
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] rendered as a vintage halftone CMYK print: coarse visible dot grid, slight chromatic misregistration, warm cream paper ground, muted palette with one orange accent, generous soft-sky negative space for headline, flat print finish, no gloss

collections.name: Dither Mono
collections.description: Stark black-and-white with bitmap/dither texture. Serif display carrying full authority. Split-screen form-plus-art layouts. Grain everywhere.
collections.deployFor: Portfolios, agencies, waitlists - anywhere restraint reads as confidence.
collections.risk: Dither the entire hero image to 1-bit and let a cropped wordmark run off the viewport
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as a stark black-and-white image with heavy 1-bit bitmap dither / coarse film grain, high contrast, dramatic single light source, dark studio or void background, no color, no midtone smoothness - texture must read as deliberate machine processing

collections.name: Vast Quiet Cinematic
collections.description: One enormous atmospheric landscape - mist, fog, dusk grade - with tiny restrained type floating in it. Silence as scale.
collections.deployFor: Enterprise trust, frontier-company gravitas, serious AI/infra brands.
collections.risk: Let the landscape occupy 90% of the viewport and shrink the headline to whisper size
collections.imageStyle: vast aerial photograph of [SUBJECT], heavy mist and fog atmosphere, desaturated cinematic color grade (pale fog whites or deep teal dusk), upper half dissolving into pale featureless sky for headline space, epic scale, no people, matte photographic finish

collections.name: Data-as-Texture
collections.description: Imagery literally rendered from the machine's alphabet - ASCII clouds, binary skies, monochrome 3D worlds. The product's data made visible.
collections.deployFor: AI and technical products that deserve spectacle without stock-3D slop.
collections.risk: Rebuild the hero photo out of the product's own log output or characters
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] constructed entirely from tiny monospace characters (binary digits, ASCII glyphs) varying in density to form the image, characters in amber or blue on a dark teal or white ground, photographic composition but data-native material, crisp legible glyphs up close

collections.name: Classical Remix
collections.description: Renaissance painting and classical sculpture colliding with soft modern UI. Serif italic emphasis. Gold details. Timeless gravitas humanizing new tech.
collections.deployFor: Heavy or intimidating domains - legal, finance, psychology - that need warmth and weight at once.
collections.risk: Put a 500-year-old artwork behind a chat input and let them share the frame
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] painted as a Renaissance / Baroque oil painting: allegorical figure or classical scene, soft sky-blue ground with rolling clouds, warm flesh tones and gold accents, flowing drapery, visible canvas grain, museum-grade composition with clear negative space on one side

collections.name: Glitched Antiquity
collections.description: Classical artwork corrupted by the machine: engraved angels and statues under glyph rain, datamosh streaks, chromatic glitch. Dark grounds, serif or dot-matrix display. Five centuries of gravitas, one pass through the shredder.
collections.deployFor: Crypto/fintech, nightlife, culture brands wanting old-world weight with digital menace.
collections.risk: Visibly corrupt the masterpiece - let glitch eat the artwork's edge
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as a classical statue or vintage engraving being corrupted by digital glitch: cascading ASCII/numeral glyph rain, datamosh smears, chromatic aberration at the edges, near-black ground with one saturated accent color, dramatic single light

collections.name: Illustrated Storybook
collections.description: Painterly illustrated worlds with chunky display type or type-masking. Warm, humane, a little wondrous - consumer without being childish.
collections.deployFor: Consumer products selling warmth, curiosity, delight.
collections.risk: Mask the entire brand wordmark over the illustrated scene so letters become windows
collections.imageStyle: [SUBJECT] as a painterly storybook illustration: gouache/animation-background style, saturated but cohesively graded palette, soft painted light, wondrous but not childish, cinematic composition with a clear zone of calm sky or water for type

entries.title: CRIX - Dreamscape Product
vocabulary: white fog fade into page content
rounded white cards with soft deep shadows
entries.note: Let one dreamlike landscape establish the atmosphere, then reuse it behind product-detail cards and the footer to connect the whole page. Closest to Vast Quiet Cinematic through its scale, mist, and landscape-led identity, but warmer and more product-dense than the collection's quietest examples. Reference includes body layouts, pricing, a testimonial, and a closing CTA; treat its copy and endorsements as mockup content, not reusable product facts.
entries.imageRecipe: dreamlike cinematic landscape of [SUBJECT: layered mountain peaks above a sea of clouds], soft peach and pale pink sunrise with powder-blue shadows, delicate alpine flowers at the lower edges, one minimal pale stone rectangular portal on the horizon, airy atmospheric depth and soft natural light, matte photographic treatment, upper third fading into almost-white open sky for headline space, central lower area kept calm for a separately composited product screenshot, no text, no logos, no dashboard or interface elements
entries.heroUsage: wide landscape behind a real HTML product screenshot centered in the lower half; headline sits upper-left in the pale sky with a separate CTA on the right; landscape and dashboard fade through white mist into the body. Reuse the landscape treatment in feature-card art and the footer; keep interface text, cards, and wordmark in code. This reference is a two-column presentation of a long page, not a two-column live-page layout.
